notes: Slab i (i = 0..n_stories-1) occupies Z in [i*story_height, i*story_height + slab_thickness]. Columns run continuously from Z=0 to Z = n_stories * story_height, passing through every slab. Column centres are on an evenly-spaced (column_grid[0] x column_grid[1]) lattice inscribed in the floor plate, including the corners.
